lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots arranged in a semi-stochastic grid following the lateral line, with the highest concentration appearing in the mid-lateral region posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal spot patterns to form a grid-like matrix, most prominent in the region immediately following the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge running horizontally across the upper third of the visible body, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the upper edge and shadowing below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, elongated, high-luminance symbiotic organism (remora) attached to the ventral surface near the base of the pectoral fin.
